messages.author: d7a0a25553050e47
messages.subject: pkde error: ud @ ctmm
parts:
Hi Chris,

I'm new to the package and working on creating a pkde for 87 Lesser Yellowlegs within the stopover region. These individuals come from 7 different breeding populations and have different number of GPS points in the stopover region (ranging 1-28 fixes). I have built akdes for each individual, now I would like to make (1) pkdes for the entire group of 87 birds, and (2) pkdes for each of the 7 breeding populations. 

This the code and error I am getting when attempting (1):

LEYE_pkde <- pkde(LEYE_all_tel, individual_akdes)

Where LEYE_all_tel is a list of telemetry objects (from Movebank)
individual_akdes is a list of the same length of UDs (created with akde function)

Error in ud@CTMM :
  no applicable method for `@` applied to an object of class "list"

I have not attempted (2) as I have not figured out how to specify a within a list for different pkdes. I am also wondering if I should be using the mean function instead.

Happy to send .rda files if that would be helpful. Thank you very much for assistance!

Rozy

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: pkde error: ud @ ctmm
parts:
Hi Rozy,

Both should be possible.

What is class(individual_akdes[[1]]) here?

mean() doesn't extrapolate to other individuals or stopover sites. pkde() extrapolates to a larger statistical population.

Best,
Chris

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: pkde error: ud @ ctmm
parts:
Hi Rozy,

sapply(LEYE_all_tel,class)

shows 3 elements that are not UD objects but lists containing identical fit objects (IID with an 18.82274 m^2 area and infinite uncertainty).
If the DOF is small enough, akde() can output a fit object to prevent an OOM error, but it shouldn't be in a list.

Best,
Chris
